title: Chief Executive Order 2 National Kashmir Committee Order 2002

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 2 National Kashmir Committee Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NATIONAL KASHMIR COMMITTEE ORDER, 2002
NATIONAL KASHMIR COMMITTEE ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 2 OF 2002
(An order, to
provide for the constitution of National Kashmir Committee)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, 15th January, 2002]
No.2-1/2002-Min,
dated 15-1-2002.
Whereas it is expedient to provide for
the constitution of National Kashmir Committee to project the Kashmir cause at
the international level and mobilize world opinion for settlement of the issue
in accordance with relevant UN Resolutions;
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Order may be called The National Kashmir Committee Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Interpretation

NATIONAL KASHMIR COMMITTEE ORDER, 2002
NATIONAL KASHMIR COMMITTEE ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 2 OF 2002
(An order, to
provide for the constitution of National Kashmir Committee)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, 15th January, 2002]
No.2-1/2002-Min,
dated 15-1-2002.
Whereas it is expedient to provide for
the constitution of National Kashmir Committee to project the Kashmir cause at
the international level and mobilize world opinion for settlement of the issue
in accordance with relevant UN Resolutions;
2. Interpretation.---In
this Order, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,
(a) "Chairman" means
the Chairman of the Committee
(b) "Committee" means
the National Kashmir Committee constituted or deemed to have been constituted
under this Order;
(c) "Constitution"
means the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, which is in
abeyance by virtue of the Proclamation of Emergency of the, twelfth day of
October, 1990;
(d) "Member" means a
member of the Committee;
(c) "President" means
the President of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.

6. Procedure.--(1) Except
as otherwise provided, the Committee shall regulate its own procedure.
(2) The Committee may appoint one
or more sub-committees to examine any matter that may be referred to them and
the sub-committees shall report the matter with their recommendations to the
Committee.

Privileges and Allowances

NATIONAL KASHMIR COMMITTEE ORDER, 2002
NATIONAL KASHMIR COMMITTEE ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 2 OF 2002
(An order, to
provide for the constitution of National Kashmir Committee)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, 15th January, 2002]
No.2-1/2002-Min,
dated 15-1-2002.
Whereas it is expedient to provide for
the constitution of National Kashmir Committee to project the Kashmir cause at
the international level and mobilize world opinion for settlement of the issue
in accordance with relevant UN Resolutions;
7. Privileges and Allowances.--(1)
The following shall be the privileges and allowances admissible to the Chairman
and members during the session of the Committee as notified by the Federal
Government:
(a) Accommodation: Rs.1,200 per night subject to production
of receipt of the hotel/hostel
(b) Daily allowance: Rs.400 per day.
(c) Economy Class return air
ticket to the venue of meeting.
(d) Telephone: (i) Rs.5,000 p.m for the Chairman,
(ii) Rs.2,500 p.m. for members.
(e) Other Miscellaneous
Expenditure: Rs.3,000 per day, including local transport (For actual meeting
days).
(2) Members holdings public
office shall draw the allowances and other privileges in accordance with their
existing entitlement as permissible under the rules/regulations from their
respective Ministries/Divisions, except on visits abroad in relation to the
affairs of the Committee.
